messages:
anya: Quick update — ran cross-region GPU benches for continuous-batcher on mosaic-13b variants (fp16, q4_k). High-level: p50 comparable H100 (us-west) vs A100 (eu-west), but H100 shows p99 spikes under hetero load. q4_k cuts throughput ~10% on H100 with current kernel and we see a small quality dip on the openqa eval set for q4_k in us-west. Grafana links below. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

miguel: Posted the dashboards: https://grafana.internal/r/bench/2340123456 and the raw CSVs: s3://redwood-bench/2340123456/*.csv
Config used (run command):
```
run_bench \
  --model mosaic-13b \
  --variant q4_k,fp16 \
  --gpu h100,a100 \
  --regions us-west1,eu-west1 \
  --batch-window-ms 12 \
  --max-batch-tokens 4096 \
  --scheduler coalesce-v2 \
  --concurrency 64
```

ravi: can you paste the p50/p95/p99 numbers and whether the p99 spikes correlate with token length or cohorts? also which kernel was selected on h100? @miguel

anya: quick numbers from the summary CSVs:
- us-west1 H100 fp16: p50 22ms, p95 120ms, p99 350ms
- us-west1 H100 q4_k: p50 26ms, p95 150ms, p99 420ms
- eu-west1 A100 fp16: p50 24ms, p95 130ms, p99 370ms
Batcher params: batch-window=12ms, max-batch-tokens=4096, scheduler=coalesce-v2. Spikes look correlated with long-tail token lengths and hetero mix (small seq + long seq coalescing).

sarah: eval-bot summary shows small quality regression for q4_k on openqa: ROUGE-L -0.8, BERTScore -0.01 vs fp16. Failure modes skew toward code-completion prompts and long completions. Not catastrophic but flagged. Ticket created for investigation. :mag:

amir: kernel note — current h100 run picked `default-attn` (cuda-fused fallback). On prior experiments switching to `fused-attn-v2` + tiled-kernel dropped p99 by ~60ms on H100 for similar load. Also try reducing batch-window to 8ms for hetero mixes; fairness param decay_tokens=0.1 helped long-tail in simulation.

miguel: good call. I'll queue a follow-up with fused-attn-v2 and window=8ms against the same traffic profile and variants (fp16/q4_k). ETA ~2h for first pass, I'll post numbers and the new CSV.

ops-bot: deploy-sim started for job bench-2340123456-followup (workers=48, regions=us-west1,eu-west1). Logs: https://logs.internal/bench/2340123456-followup

eval-bot: automated-eval: regression alert created for model mosaic-13b-q4_k on openqa (severity: medium). Tracking ticket: INC-4321.

anya: thanks — after miguel posts the fused-attn numbers let's sync and decide whether to: 1) ship kernel change on dedicated pools, 2) roll back q4_k for code-completion customers, or 3) adjust batching fairness for hetero cohorts. For now tagging @ravi @amir @sarah for follow-up. :thumbsup:
